provenance: AUTHORED - every personality, voice setting, binding choice, split assignment, bound, template and coaching rule in this file is written by hand. A binding names WHERE a line is quoted from; it adds no line and no fact. Template words are AUTHORED; every number a template prints is MEASURED by robotics/claw/core.mjs at build or view time. No figure here represents a real person.

scheduler.name: Scheduler
scheduler.job: builds the tournament queue: policies x tasks x levels x seeds
scheduler.style: Reads the queue out as counts, then says which run goes first.

lines.template: The queue holds {runs} runs: {policies} policies, {tasks} tasks, {levels} task levels, {seeds} seeds each.

referee.name: Referee
referee.job: applies each task's own termination and success rules
referee.style: Quotes the rule first, then the count it produced, and nothing else.

lines.template: {success} of {runs} runs met the success rule; {cap} reached the step cap; {disagree} outcomes disagreed with the rule.

steward.name: Data Steward
steward.job: assembles the datasets and enforces consent scope and revocations
steward.style: Says what was refused before what was kept.

lines.template: {samples} samples kept from {episodes} seeded episodes; {duplicates} duplicate trajectories removed; {revoked} revoked episodes excluded.

evaluator.name: Evaluator
evaluator.job: compares policies with paired statistics on the same task, level and seed
evaluator.style: Gives the paired count first and the p-value second, and never calls a difference real on its own.

lines.template: Over {pairs} paired runs, {a_only} finished only under the first policy and {b_only} only under the second; exact sign-test p = {p}.

coach.name: Coach
coach.job: turns a learner's measured episode into a next-lesson or next-level suggestion
coach.style: Names one measured thing that went well, then one thing to try next.

lines.template: Smoothness index {smooth} and {collisions} contacts on this run.
Finished in {time} seconds; path efficiency {eff} against the reference on the same seed.

seen-tasks.rule: every task family appears in every split; the seed sets are disjoint

unseen-tasks.rule: whole task families are held out; no family, instruction or trajectory appears in two splits

balance.rule: per-task sample counts may differ by at most max_ratio (largest / smallest); every sample carries weight = N / (tasks x n_task) so each task weighs the same in every split

metrics.smoothness: mean over consecutive 5 Hz samples of |delta a| / (high - low), averaged over the action fields; 0 = constant inputs, lower is smoother (changes faster than the sample rate are not seen)
metrics.path_efficiency: reference path length / learner path length over the 5 Hz pose samples, same env, seed and level, measured only when both the learner and the reference met the success rule (otherwise -1, not shown); above 1 means a shorter path than the reference
metrics.collisions: contacts = collision term / its reward weight, as robotics/bench.mjs counts them
metrics.time_to_success_s: steps x dt_s when the episode met the success rule, otherwise none

rules.say: The reference policy does not finish this seed either. Practise on the level where it finishes most often, then come back.
Stay on this level. Slow down before the obstacles and watch the contact count.
Stay on this level. Watch the reference replay once, then drive it again.
Finished. Try the same level again with no contacts.
Finished cleanly. Try the same level again with steadier inputs.
Finished cleanly. Try the same level again on a shorter line.
Clean, smooth and efficient. Move on to the next step.
